extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent attorneys/agents, and USPTO examiners handling appeals
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and substantive rules in the MPEP Chapter 1200 governing appeals from USPTO examiners to the Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB), including briefs, examiner answers, hearings, remands, and judicial review. Intended to guide preparation, filing, and prosecution of appeals in U.S. patent practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1201: Introduction
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction to MPEP Chapter 1200 on appeals.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1202: Composition of Board
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on the composition of the Board (PTAB) that decides appeals.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1203: Administrative Handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for administrative handling of appeals at the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1204: Notice of Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures for filing a Notice of Appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1204.01: Reinstatement of Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for reinstating an appeal that was not timely prosecuted or otherwise disrupted.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1204.02: Pre-Appeal Brief Review Request and Conference Pilot Program
rubrics_metrics.description: Program and procedures for requesting a pre-appeal brief review and conference to potentially resolve issues before a full appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1204.03: Interviews After Notice of Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and guidance on conducting interviews with the examiner after a Notice of Appeal has been filed.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1204.04: Official Record on Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and scope of the official record that will be considered on appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1205: Appeal Brief
rubrics_metrics.description: General guidance about the appeal brief as the appellant's principal submission to the Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1205.01: Time for Filing Appeal Brief
rubrics_metrics.description: Deadlines and timing rules for filing the appeal brief.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1205.02: Appeal Brief Content
rubrics_metrics.description: Required contents and organization of an appeal brief (issues to be raised, arguments, claims at issue, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: 1205.03: Non-Compliant Appeal Brief and Amended Brief
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and consequences when an appeal brief does not comply with rules and for filing amended briefs.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1206: Amendments and Affidavits or Other Evidence Filed With or After Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for submitting claim amendments, affidavits, declarations, or other evidence with or after filing an appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1207: Examiner’s Answer
rubrics_metrics.description: The examiner's response to the appeal brief and the procedures surrounding that response.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1207.01: Appeal Conference
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on the appeal conference that may occur during the examiner's consideration of the appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1207.02: Contents of Examiner’s Answer
rubrics_metrics.description: What must be included in the examiner's answer to an appeal brief and how it should be presented.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1207.03: New Ground of Rejection in Examiner’s Answer
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules addressing when the examiner's answer contains a new ground of rejection not previously made in the prosecution record.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1207.03(a): Determining Whether a Ground of Rejection is New
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and analysis for assessing whether a ground of rejection in the examiner's answer is a 'new' ground.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1207.03(b): Petition to Designate a New Ground of Rejection and to Reopen Prosecution
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for petitioning to have an examiner's answer designated as a new ground of rejection and to request reopening prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1207.03(c): Appellant's Reply to New Grounds of Rejection
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for the appellant's reply when new grounds of rejection are asserted in the examiner's answer.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1207.04: Reopening of Prosecution After Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances and procedures for reopening prosecution following appeal activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1207.05: Substitute Examiner’s Answer
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures allowing a substitute examiner's answer under specified circumstances.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1208: Reply Briefs and Fee for Forwarding Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for filing reply briefs and any applicable fees for forwarding the appeal to the Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1208.01: Fee for Forwarding an Appeal to the Board
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifics about the fee required to forward an appeal to the Board (if applicable).

rubrics_metrics.name: 1209: Oral Hearing
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures, scheduling, and conduct of an oral hearing before the Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1210: Actions Subsequent to Examiner’s Answer but Before Board’s Decision
rubrics_metrics.description: Permissible actions and procedures that may occur after the examiner's answer but prior to the Board issuing a decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1211: Remand by Director or Board
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances and procedures for remand of an appeal by the Director or the Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1211.01: Remand by Board for Further Consideration of Rejection
rubrics_metrics.description: Remand when the Board directs further consideration of a rejection by the examiner.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1211.02: Remand To Consider Amendment
rubrics_metrics.description: Remand procedures when the Board sends the application back to consider an amendment.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1211.03: Remand To Consider Affidavits or Declarations
rubrics_metrics.description: Remand to consider affidavits or declarations submitted during the appeal process.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1211.04: Remand by Board for Further Search
rubrics_metrics.description: Remand for the examiner to conduct an additional search of the prior art or record.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1212: Board Requires Appellant to Address Matter
rubrics_metrics.description: Instances where the Board may require the appellant to address specific matters and the procedure for doing so.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1213: Decision by Board
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and disposition types for the Board's decision on appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1213.01: Reserved
rubrics_metrics.description: Reserved subsection (no content provided in index).

rubrics_metrics.name: 1213.02: New Grounds of Rejection by Board
rubrics_metrics.description: When and how the Board may raise new grounds of rejection in its decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1213.03: Publication of and Public Access to Board Decision
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies on publication and public availability of Board decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1214: Procedure Following Decision by Board
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures to follow after the Board issues its decision, including actions by the examiner or appellant.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1214.01: Procedure Following New Ground of Rejection by Board
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific procedure when the Board's decision includes a new ground of rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1214.02: Reserved
rubrics_metrics.description: Reserved subsection (no content provided in index).

rubrics_metrics.name: 1214.03: Rehearing
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for requesting rehearing of a Board decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1214.04: Examiner Reversed in Whole
rubrics_metrics.description: Consequences and procedure when the examiner is reversed in whole by the Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1214.05: Cancellation of Claims Not Appealed
rubrics_metrics.description: Handling of claims that were not appealed but are affected by a Board decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1214.06: Examiner Sustained in Whole or in Part; Claims Require Action
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure when the examiner is sustained, in whole or in part, and claims require further action.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1214.07: Reopening of Prosecution
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on reopening prosecution in light of the Board's decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1215: Withdrawal or Dismissal of Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and procedures for withdrawing or dismissing an appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1215.01: Withdrawal of Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure for voluntarily withdrawing an appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1215.02: Claims Standing Allowed
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances in which claims remain allowed or stand allowed following appeal actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1215.03: Partial Withdrawal
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for partial withdrawal of an appeal as to certain claims or issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1215.04: Dismissal of Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Situations and procedure for dismissal of an appeal by the USPTO or Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1216: Judicial Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Options and procedures for judicial review following Board decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1216.01: Appeals to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and considerations for appealing Board decisions to the Federal Circuit.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1216.02: Civil Suits Under 35 U.S.C. 145 and 146
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and guidance for bringing civil actions under 35 U.S.C. 145 and 146 as alternatives to Federal Circuit appeals.
